stem: Room-average drying conditions are within the approved range, but one rack repeatedly remains wetter than comparable racks. What is the strongest next step?
choices: Change the entire room setpoint immediately
Investigate rack-specific loading, airflow, location, and representative product-condition evidence before changing the whole room
Assume the room-average data prove the rack is acceptable
Release the rack because only one location differs
rationale: Acceptable room averages can conceal local distribution problems. Technician II should investigate local loading/airflow and representative evidence before making a system-wide correction.
